repos_data.description: A unified trading API with more than 100 crypto exchanges and prediction markets in JavaScript / TypeScript / Python / C# / PHP / Go / Java / Rust
CCXT for prediction markets. PMXT is a unified API for trading on Polymarket, Kalshi, and more.

Oracle3: open-source trading engine and MCP server for prediction markets. Finds fee-adjusted no-arbitrage violations across related event contracts and trades them live on Kalshi, Polymarket and Solana, or on paper, under pre-trade risk limits. 13 MCP tools, JSON CLI, agent skills, 600+ tests.
A Polymarket sports market-making / arbitrage bot in Python - de-vig sportsbook odds, quote, hedge. The retired code behind a public $5k wallet.

Multi-DEX perpetual futures CLI + MCP server for traders and AI agents — trade on Hyperliquid (incl. HIP-3), Pacifica, Lighter, Aster, Ondo, Arcus, QFEX and more; funding-rate arb, portfolio, bots, bridge. 31 MCP tools, agent skill, JSON output.
Quantitative Risk & Slippage Guard for AI Agents: Polymarket L2 VWAP, On-chain DEX & Cross-Venue Arbitrage (x402 Remote MCP)

MCP server for live cross-DEX crypto prices — per-venue pool price, liquidity and gross cross-venue spread on 6 EVM chains (BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Avalanche, Optimism), read from on-chain pool state. Works keyless. For Claude, Cursor and any MCP client.
